root_cause.text: In vfio_pci_core_close_device(), the vfio/pci shutdown sequence disabled the PCI function before revoking exported MMIO dma-buf mappings, leaving a race window where dma-buf users could still access BAR memory after MSE was cleared and resources could be reassigned.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves `vfio_pci_dma_buf_cleanup(vdev);` to execute before `vfio_pci_core_disable(vdev);`, and the commit/CVE explicitly state that disabling first left “a tiny window” where “BARs could still be accessed via the DMABUF” and “resources would also be freed and up for grabs by a different driver.”

intent_record.intent_summary: Reorder vfio_pci device shutdown so DMA-buf cleanup happens before disabling the device.
intent_record.what: The call to vfio_pci_core_disable(vdev) was moved from before vfio_pci_dma_buf_cleanup(vdev) to after it in vfio_pci_core_close_device(), with no other code changes.
intent_record.how: At runtime, device DMA-buf cleanup now occurs while the PCI device is still enabled, and the device is disabled only afterward. This changes the shutdown sequence to avoid cleaning up DMA-buf state after the device has already been disabled.

grouping_result.intent: Reorder vfio_pci device shutdown so DMA-buf cleanup happens before disabling the device.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly matches the root cause by reordering vfio_pci shutdown so dma-buf/MMIO mappings are revoked before the PCI device is disabled, eliminating the race window described.

candidates.rationale: This is the directly vulnerable operation: it disables the PCI function before exported MMIO dma-buf mappings are cleaned up, creating the race window described in the root cause.
This cleanup happened only after the device was disabled in the pre-fix ordering, which is the flawed sequencing that allowed dma-buf users to retain access during shutdown.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement disables the PCI function before exported MMIO dma-buf mappings are revoked, creating the race window described in the root cause where dma-buf users can still access BAR memory after MSE is cleared.

This cleanup statement occurred only after the device disable in the pre-fix shutdown ordering, meaning revocation of exported MMIO dma-buf mappings was delayed until after the vulnerable state was entered.

In `vfio_pci_core_close_device()`, the code does `vfio_pci_core_disable(vdev);` and only afterward calls `vfio_pci_dma_buf_cleanup(vdev);`.
